strings.name: László Krasznahorkai
strings.summary: Born in Gyula, Hungary, Krasznahorkai studied law and literature. His extended sentences, dark humor and apocalyptic settings portray societies and individuals in upheaval. Béla Tarr adapted Satantango and The Melancholy of Resistance into films. He won the 2015 International Booker, then an award for a writer's body of work, and the 2025 Nobel Prize. Travel and cross-cultural artistic interests also inform his fiction; translations and film collaborations expanded its international circulation.
